proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ α A H X hH hX hperp
  have h0 : inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (H -ᵥ X) = 0 := hperp _ (AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hH hX)
  have h1 : dist A X ^ 2 = dist A H ^ 2 + dist H X ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A X, dist_eq_norm_vsub V A H, dist_eq_norm_vsub V H X, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel A H X,
      norm_add_sq_real, h0]
    ring
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  exact abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist H X)]) dist_nonneg |>.2
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (α : AffineSubspace ℝ P) (A H X : P), H ∈ α → X ∈ α → (∀ w ∈ α.direction, inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) w = 0) → dist A X ^ 2 = dist A H ^ 2 + dist H X ^ 2 ∧ dist A H ≤ dist A X
